summary: First National Funding LLC filed an 8-K reporting the entry into an Underwriting Agreement for a Series 2026-1 asset-backed note issuance by First National Master Note Trust. The filing covers the offering of Class A notes underwritten by J.P. Morgan, Wells Fargo, and BMO. It also notes the execution of a related indenture supplement and a risk retention agreement. This is a routine structured finance transaction—a standard ABS shelf takedown—not a special situation. The filing discloses ordinary operational steps for issuing asset-backed securities, with no change of control, acquisition, divestiture, or other transformative event involved. What to watch: typical ABS market execution, no risk-arb angle.
